steps: Created Workspace.SiegeArena model (floor + neon DefensePoint) as the spawn ring center
Authored config-driven wave lifecycle with [Siege]-tagged prints

recipe.text: Concept 'Escalating Siege': a CONFIG.Waves table drives count + health/speed scaling per wave. runSiege() iterates waves; spawnWave() builds self-contained brute enemies (Humanoid+HRP+Head) on a spawn ring around DefensePoint, gives each a chase AI, and counts Humanoid.Died to detect wave-clear. After the final wave clears it logs VICTORY. Enemies die only from real player combat (TakeDamage) — no auto-kill hook. All lifecycle events print with the [Siege] tag for VERIFY.
